GET Connection Settings

Read your NinjaTrader connection settings: auto-reconnect, data watchdog, what happens after a reconnect, and opposing-position protection. Works while the add-on is offline.

For live status or an immediate connect/disconnect command, use NT8 Connections.

ELITE

The Management API requires an Elite subscription. See Authentication.

Endpoint​

GET https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connection-settings

Headers​
NAME	REQUIRED	VALUE
Authorization	Yes	Bearer <your API token>
If-None-Match	No	ETag from a previous read. Returns 304 with no body if nothing changed
Code examples​
Python
cURL
import requests



resp = requests.get(

    "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/nt8/connection-settings",

    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},

)

print(resp.json())

Responses​
200
Other responses
{

  "success": true,

  "data": {

    "autoReconnect": [ { "connection": "Rithmic", "enabled": true, "timeoutSeconds": 60 } ],

    "dataWatchdog": [ { "connection": "Rithmic", "enabled": false, "timeoutSeconds": 60 } ],

    "reconnectActions": {

      "restartStrategies": true,

      "flatten": { "scope": "specific", "accounts": ["Sim101"] }

    },

    "opposingPositionProtection": {

      "enabled": true,

      "checkAllAccounts": false,

      "relatedProducts": [["ES", "MES"], ["NQ", "MNQ"]],

      "relatedProductsSource": "custom",

      "groups": [ { "name": "Prop accounts", "accounts": ["PROP1234", "PROP1235"] } ]

    }

  },

  "meta": { "requestId": "req_9f2c1a0b7d3e4f51", "etag": "\"c2:7Q0xMmZ3bTRkWmRVdz\"" }

}

Notes​

Field details are in the Connection settings field reference.
